title: GUI: Stop setting wmtype
body:
Setting the wmtype seems to cause a lot of trouble (#1511).

We sometimes set the wmtype because we like to have dialogs, but this no longer seems to *actually* make those windows dialogs.  Also, the original reason to do this was to get open/close dialogs to be modal.  Nowadays they are always modal, and the snippets hacking modal-dialog-behaviour were commented as unnecessary from python3.8+.

I don't observe that setting the wmtype has any effect, since windows appear in the same place and with the same properties (modality, focus reception, etc.) no matter what.

This MR therefore removes all the wmtype stuff.

- [ ] [**Issue is resolved** via "closes #XXXX" if applicable.](https://docs.gitlab.com/ee/user/project/issues/managing_issues.html#closing-issues-automatically)

comments.author: askhl
comments.body:
@miro.ilias @rartino @kirkbadger18 @dipayanster @patrickmelix Could you please check if this is okay?

I realize now that I already tried this once, back in !3479.  @patrickmelix you reported some issue with that.  Would you mind having a look?  I cannot imagine how a functional installation would not work when we do *not* set the wm-specific "wmtype".  After all that would be the *default tkinter* behaviour on that system.  So if this MR doesn't work then I'd say "that's a distro/packaging problem" and we look into filing bugs elsewhere.
